data.one_liner: A wrapper for the PDFTron mobile SDK to view and annotate PDF documents.
data.what_it_does: It provides a convenience wrapper around the native PDFTron SDKs for Flutter apps to handle document viewing and annotating. Developers can present documents using either a plugin or a dedicated DocumentView widget.
use_when: You need robust out-of-the-box PDF viewing and annotation capabilities inside your Flutter app.
You want to leverage the native PDFTron (Apryse) SDK functionality via a Flutter plugin or widget.
avoid_when: You require deep and complex custom modifications to the lower-level functionality of the native SDK.
You want a pure Dart-based PDF rendering engine without relying on large native wrapper binaries.
strengths: Smooth and flexible stand-alone document viewing.
Supports both Android and iOS platforms with options for Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods.
Comes with built-in features for handling annotations and document configuration.
weaknesses: Exposes only a limited set of APIs from the native SDKs.
Requires platform-specific setup steps (such as modifying Android build files or iOS deployment targets).
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration including setting a PDFTRON_LICENSE_KEY, configuring Android permissions/MainActivity, and setting the minimum iOS deployment target to 13.0.
